issues.jp_before: 試合[しあい]{の|no-possessive}判定[はんてい]{をめぐって|womegutte}、観客[かんきゃく]{が|ga-subject}怒[おこ]りました。
issues.problem: をめぐって needs a predicate of dispute/contention between parties; one side simply getting angry is unnatural with it.
issues.action: Rewrote as 監督が審判に抗議しました (manager protested to the referee), English and why updated.

issues.jp_before: 田中[たなか]さん{は|wa-topic}英語[えいご]{に加[くわ]えて|nikuwaete}フランス語[ふらんすご]{も|mo-also}話[はな]せます。
issues.problem: Furigana covered the katakana too: フランス語[ふらんすご]; the reading must cover only the kanji 語.
issues.action: Changed to フランス語[ご].

issues.jp_before: 彼[かれ]{は/が|wa-topic}成績[せいせき]{に加[くわ]えて|nikuwaete}人柄[ひとがら]{も|mo-also}よくて、みんな{に|passive-agent}好[す]かれています。
issues.problem: English 'Besides his grades, his personality is good too' was awkward and did not render the meaning naturally.
issues.action: English changed to 'On top of good grades, he has a good personality too, so everyone likes him.'

issues.jp_before: 先生[せんせい]{は|wa-topic}宿題[しゅくだい]{に加[くわ]えて|nikuwaete}、日記[にっき]{も|mo-also}出[だ]しました。
issues.problem: 日記も出しました is unnatural/ambiguous for 'assigned a diary' (reads as submitting a diary).
issues.action: Rewrote as 漢字の宿題に加えて、作文も出しました; f moved to 2; English updated.

issues.problem: 山に登る is equally natural here and was not listed.

issues.jp_before: 夜[よる]{が|ga-subject}更[ふ]ける{につれて/に従[したが]って/とともに|nitsurete}、町[まち]{は/が|wa-topic}静[しず]か{に|ni-change}なりました。
